title: Design Partners | ContextMint
description: ContextMint design partner intake opens by start of September 2026. Pilot program details for fintech, platform, and regulated engineering teams.

hero.title: Co-build governable AI for engineering teams
hero.leadBefore: We are recruiting a small cohort of design partners — especially in
hero.leadStrong1: fintech, platform engineering, and regulated digital teams
hero.leadMid: — to pilot ContextMint before general availability. Intake opens
hero.leadAfter: . The program outline below is for reference; the form is paused until then.

pilot.title: The 30-day evaluation pilot
pilot.leadBefore: A design partner pilot is a
pilot.leadAfter: — not a subscription that ends after 30 days, and not a requirement for a 30-minute sales call to start (async via the form is fine).
commitItems: Named pilot lead (platform, security, or engineering)
30 calendar days of real dev usage after onboarding
deliverItems: Install help + deployment path review (local or on-prem)
Weekly async check-in during the pilot month
Written pilot summary for security and platform stakeholders
Option to extend to 90 days if the pilot is going well

getItems.text: Early access to ContextMint Engine + VS Code extension
Local-first deployment — or shared on-prem server with guided path review
Context Lens + quality map for audit-friendly AI-assisted development
Pilot summary report for your security and platform stakeholders

askItems: Honest assessment of fit for regulated / sovereign AI dev workflows
If Track B matters: which systems to connect first (Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, etc.)
Willingness to share blocker-level feedback — not a marketing testimonial

next.title: What we are building next
next.leadBefore: Design partners shape three horizons — not just today’s pilot. See the full
next.v1Text: Engine, Context Lens, quality map, symbol-aware retrieval — shipping 30 September 2026.
next.v2Text: Knowledge Fabric, institutional memory, CHRONOS forensics, operational intelligence retrieval — one digital twin of your engineering system.
next.trackBText: Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Git, and org knowledge bases — plus SSO/RBAC, multi-tenant isolation, tamper-evident audit, and SOC 2 evidence packaging.
next.footerMid: (Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Git, and other knowledge bases)? Note that in the form when intake opens — we prioritize partners who need unified org knowledge and compliance evidence, not just IDE chat.

fit.title: Ideal fit
fit.card1Strong: You blocked or limited ungoverned AI in the IDE
fit.card1Text: Because of data residency, audit requirements, or auto-edits without evidence or approval.
fit.card2Text: Human gates before inference and before apply — with logs your reviewers can trust.
